title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2610.02117v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. translated_title: Where-OPD：基于合成场景的空间引导多模态大语言模型在线策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏近来已成为提升语言模型推理能力的有效方法，其核心思想是让模型自身的一个冻结或指数移动平均（EMA）版本接收特权信息，以此来监督学生模型。然而，这一方法在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）上的应用在很大程度上仍处于空白。近期的方法使用特权视觉信息（例如与问题对应的图像裁剪区域）来改进细粒度感知，但其收益仅限于能从这种视觉放大中受益的任务，且需要人工标注的定位数据或外部教师模型。我们为MLLM提出了一种不同形式的在线策略自蒸馏，为教师模型提供文本形式的、基于空间定位的指导，用以识别与查询相关的视觉元素。我们使用程序化生成的场景，其中物体身份与空间坐标可以自动获得，从而实现可扩展且无需标注的训练监督。
tldr: 该论文提出Where-OPD，通过程序化合成场景自动获取物体空间坐标，为多模态大语言模型自蒸馏中的教师模型提供文本化空间引导，实现了无需人工标注、可扩展的细粒度视觉感知能力提升。
en_tdlr: Where-OPD introduces a new form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs, using procedurally generated synthetic scenes with automatically available object coordinates to provide the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance, enabling scalable and annotation-free improvement of fine-grained visual perception.
